sections.heading: Nextiva limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included; Analytics and AI assistance require Scale / higher plans or XBert add-on from list price; Power dialer depth is contact-centre Professional territory, not Core because it forces process changes or add-ons around Nextiva when cloud phone is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Core with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain call recording (Core, Engage, Scale, Contact Center Essential) at the expense of Entry price and seat minimums vs routing, CTI and analytics depth — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Core · cloud phone | Engage | Scale.

Alternative context: unlike Aircall, Nextiva is preferable when SMB teams wanting a clear list price Core annual cloud-phone floor because cloud phone plus call recording (Core, Engage, Scale, Contact Center Essential) match; prefer Aircall when Buyers who need call recording, analytics and AI included on the cheapest seat because the operating loops differ.

sections.heading: Decision scenario and conclusion for Nextiva
sections.body:
Workflow advantage: Nextiva is faster for cloud phone when cloud phone; call routing; call recording; power dialer is in-product; skip when Call recording is an add-on on Core rather than included because that loop lives elsewhere.

Implementation complexity: setup requires confirming call recording (Core, Engage, Scale, Contact Center Essential) ownership and Salesforce before rollout — do not scale seats first.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack.

Conclusion: Nextiva is worth it if SMB teams wanting a clear list price Core annual cloud-phone floor and call recording (Core, Engage, Scale, Contact Center Essential) are weekly; skip Nextiva if Buyers who need call recording, analytics and AI included on the cheapest seat. That is the decision, not a template with the logo swapped.
